score_formula.rule: score_uncapped = w_e*cosine + w_f*sum_k(field_weights[k]*s_k), where s_k = hybrid_embed_weight*cosine + hybrid_char_weight*field_similarities[k] if field_semantic_types[k] is in hybrid_semantic_types, else field_similarities[k]; (w_e, w_f) = (w_embed_blend, w_field_blend), or (1, 0) when field_weights is empty; score = min(score_uncapped, score_cap). Exact-duplicate rows (pair_source exact or both) have score 1.0 by rule.

decision_status_rule: review when |score - effective_threshold| <= review_margin (inclusive, on the 6-decimal values); otherwise match when match_type is full_signal, weak_signal or embedding_only (the rows of match_candidates.csv), else non_match

column_notes.field_similarities: per-field char Jaccard: the field-only part the score uses
column_notes.evidence_field_similarities: per-field display similarity read by the evidence gate, not by the score
column_notes.applied_threshold: threshold Verity applied: learned threshold for pairs with no shared keys, effective threshold otherwise
